sara_pm: Mosaic (reseller) asks for a compact POC plan: tenant isolation vs pooled compute, per-tenant billing, and answers for their security questionnaire by next week. short sync pls.
oliver_partner: They want isolated billing and the option to share compute for cost savings. Also asked about automated tenant provisioning.
noah_sales: Pricing: need two quick scenarios for a 3-customer pilot. Can we give $/month examples and 99th pct usage estimate?
leo_infra: Yes. Rough numbers: reserved per-tenant (3 vGPU equiv) ~ $6.7k/mo each; pooled 6 vGPU pool ~ $19k/mo (~$6.3k/customer) + metered egress. Provision time: pooled 3 business days, dedicated slices 7 business days.
rita_sec: Security: confirm whether any pilot customers are in regulated sectors (HIPAA/PCI). If yes, require per-tenant CMKs and tenant-scoped audit streams. Also need to know SSO flow (brokered vs direct).
oliver_partner: Two pilot customers are regulated; Mosaic prefers brokered Okta for speed. They also want read-only log access for reseller ops with PII masking.
leo_infra: We can provide tenant-scoped read-only log views with masking toggles in console. Demo provisioning CLI snippet will be ready.
sara_pm: Owners: rita -> security appendix & KMS recommendation, leo -> infra ticket + demo pods, noah -> pricing sheet + token assumptions, oliver -> collect IdP metadata.
provision-bot: ticket-60021 created: "Mosaic POC - pooled cluster + demo tenants" (owner: leo_infra) ETA 3d.
noah_sales: I'll draft the pricing lines and include a 95th/99th token line for billing sensitivity. Sending EOD.
sara_pm: Great. let's reconvene Mon 9am PT to review the runbook and demo script. agenda: provisioning flow, entitlements UI, pricing table, security checklist. :white_check_mark:
